mapper.sql: id, username, password, email, nickname, avatar, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, email, nickname, avatar) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{avatar})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `diary` WHERE user_id = #{id} AND is_public = 1) AS post_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(like_count), 0) FROM `diary` WHERE user_id = #{id} AND is_public = 1) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` c JOIN `diary` d ON c.diary_id = d.id WHERE d.user_id = #{id}) AS comment_count, (SELECT created_at FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id}) AS created_at, (SELECT IFNULL(DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at) + 1, 0) FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id}) AS join_days
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` password = #{password}, email = #{email}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, WHERE id = #{id}
